title: Fraud Analyst
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

What you’ll be doing

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

  • Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

  • Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

  • Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

  • Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

  • Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

  • Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

  • Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

  • Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

  • Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

  • Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

  • Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

  • Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

  • Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

  • A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

  • Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

  • SQL or basic data analysis.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

  • You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

  • Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

  • Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

  • Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

  • FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

Why join us?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact.

Apply if this sounds like you

You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance.

Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

About your application

We build closely with our clients, move at a market-leading pace, and are scaling rapidly across teams and geographies.

Legal Data is the foundation of what Legora knows. The team decides which legal sources our users can rely on (legislation, case law, and commentary from leading publishers) and makes them available across a growing number of markets, through our own content build and partnerships with publishers and institutions worldwide.

The role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help Legal Data decide where to invest globally—and build the systems and cross-functional processes that turn those decisions into delivery. The role’s key responsibilities are:

  • Support content prioritisation for our digital collection. Build evidence-based recommendations on which jurisdictions, legal sources and data types to prioritise sources, balancing client needs, commercial impact, the competitive and publisher landscape, and delivery feasibility.

description:
The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces.

This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive.

Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one.

Where you'll start

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

  • Mobile: Patrol (Flutter)

  • Coverage gaps across white-labels, browser extensions, widgets, APIs and internal tooling

The tooling can stay as it is. With a clear case you can migrate or rebuild. E2E coverage today is thin, so a different platform is genuinely on the table if it serves speed, maintainability and DX better. We have no predefined answer.

AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight.

What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios.

How the role works

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role.

Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that.

What you'll own

Quality strategy and platform

  • Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health

  • Decide whether to keep, evolve or replace the current tooling, with clear trade-offs on speed, maintainability and DX

  • Set coding standards and patterns for test code, and keep the suite focused on the tests that earn their place

Release gates and telemetry

  • Build automated release gates into CI/CD and define what protects the core journeys

  • Give Product, Engineering and leadership real-time quality telemetry on release readiness, risk and pipeline health

  • Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on

Risk-based coverage and testability

  • Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs

  • Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest

  • Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps

Developer enablement

  • Make it easy for product engineers to write, run and maintain tests locally and in CI

  • Embed quality into how teams plan and ship, and mentor the insourced QA Engineer

  • Drive a measurable increase in developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX

What success looks like in 12 months

  1. Platform ownership. You have taken over the automation platform across products and own it outright, with direction, standards and health all unambiguous, whether you kept the tooling or replaced it.

  2. Gates and focus. Release gates on the core journeys are fast and deterministic, and testing effort sits on the highest-risk scenarios.

  3. Dev ownership and satisfaction. Writing and maintaining tests is a routine part of Definition of Done, and developer satisfaction with quality tooling and DX has measurably improved.

  4. Telemetry. Eng and Product work from live release-readiness and risk dashboards, failures triage cleanly, and flaky tests go into quarantine.

  5. Less manual drag. Regular releases go out without manual testing, with exploratory testing reserved for major new work.

Who you are

  • You have a track record of building or overhauling automation platforms (SWE / QE / SDET)

  • You write production-grade code across app, test and infra repos. Language matters less to us than depth, though our stack today leans on TypeScript/JS, Elixir, Go, Python and Dart.

  • You use AI agents effectively in your own engineering workflow and can judge where they belong inside a quality platform, from test generation to failure triage

  • You have cross-platform web and mobile automation judgment, and can weigh unified toolchains against separate ones objectively

  • You have deep CI/CD and test infrastructure experience: GitHub Actions, device clouds, parallelisation, test data

  • You can translate quality risk into telemetry and decisions that Eng, Product and leadership act on

  • You are a hands-on builder who wants to code the platform yourself

  • You design platforms developers adopt, and you prioritise risk-based coverage

Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background.

Why join us now?

  • Full ownership of the quality strategy and the automation platform, with a mandate for enablement

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

Take trawa beyond borders!

Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

What you bring:

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?
